decisions.reason: Changing the date display format does not alter persistent labels, help-text content, locations, or behavior.
The date format does not change how editable fields remain visually identifiable.
The date field's day/month/year format does not change whether placeholder text clears upon field activation.
The source changes date formatting only and does not affect preservation of Title-field formatting during interaction.
Selecting a date format does not necessarily change the underlying field implementation architecture or editable-text mechanism.
The date-format decision does not alter text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
Message 268 specifies only the date format; it does not establish multiline or regular-Enter behavior for the date field.
The date-format choice does not change the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
The requested day/month/year format does not replace or otherwise change the Danish date-field placeholder text or label language.
Date formatting does not affect text-to-border padding.
Applying a day/month/year date format does not change Board Meeting field alignment.
The date-format decision has no effect on the available theme-color options.
